exclusions.source_text: Age ≥18 years. Children are excluded from this study, but will be eligible for future pediatric trials.
Total bilirubin ≤ institutional upper limit of normal (ULN)

exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT > 2.5x ULN (or >5x ULN with liver metastases)

exclusions.source_text: Glomerular filtration rate (GFR) ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m2 (by Cockcroft Gault formula)
Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected participants on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months are eligible for this trial.

Participants with known history or current symptoms of cardiac disease, or history of treatment with cardiotoxic agents, should have a clinical risk assessment of cardiac function using the New York Heart Association Functional Classification. To be eligible for this trial, participants should be class 2B or better.
Female subjects of childbearing potential must have a negative urine or serum pregnancy test within 72 hours prior to receiving the first dose of study medication.
Women who are pregnant or lactating.

Have an active second malignancy. Subjects with a history of malignancy that have been completely treated, with no evidence of active cancer for 3 years prior to start of therapy on trial (Cycle 1 Day 1 [C1D1]), or subjects with surgically-cured tumors with low risk of recurrence are allowed to enroll.
exclusions.threshold: active second malignancy; no evidence of cancer for 3 years

exclusions.source_text: Have known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.
Myocardial infarction or unstable angina pectoris within 6 months prior to C1D1
New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class III or greater congestive heart failure or left ventricular ejection fraction of < 40%
exclusions.threshold: NYHA class III or greater; LVEF < 40%

exclusions.source_text: Patients with uncontrolled diabetes. Uncontrolled diabetes is defined as hemoglobin A1C >8% or 7-8% with associated diabetes symptoms that are otherwise not explained
